meta.name: receiving-code-review
meta.description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation

copy.tagline: 澄清代码评审中的技术疑问后再修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常收到模糊的代码评审意见需要澄清
copy.tagline_en: Clarify technical doubts in code reviews before making changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often receive unclear code review feedback that needs technical verification

howto.what: 收到代码审查反馈后，先完整阅读、理解并核实，再给出技术性回应或推回，避免礼貌性同意；逐一实现并测试每个修改。
howto.when: 当你收到代码审查反馈时自动触发，尤其在反馈不清楚或技术上可疑时。

say.text: 我需要澄清第4和第5条反馈后再继续。
say.note: 不清楚的条目要一起问。

say.text: 这个建议会破坏现有功能吗？我检查一下。
搜索代码库发现这个端点未被调用，应该删除吗？

howto.what_en: Upon receiving code review feedback, read completely, then understand, verify, evaluate, and respond technically. Avoid performative agreement. Clarify unclear items first. Implement one at a time and test each.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you receive code review feedback, especially if feedback is unclear or technically questionable.

say_en.text: I need clarification on items 4 and 5 before proceeding.
say_en.note: Unclear items must be asked together.

say_en.text: Does this suggestion break existing functionality? Let me check.
Grep shows this endpoint is uncalled. Should we remove it?
